# Project General Instructions

## Project Overview
This is a notes and learning project focused on GitHub Copilot documentation and examples.

## General Coding Guidelines

### Code Style
- Use semantic HTML5 elements (header, main, section, article, etc.)
- Prefer modern JavaScript (ES6+) features like const/let, arrow functions, and template literals
- Use meaningful variable and function names that clearly describe their purpose
- Include helpful comments for complex logic

### Naming Conventions
- Use camelCase for variables, functions, and methods
- Use PascalCase for component names, interfaces, and type aliases
- Use ALL_CAPS for constants
- Use kebab-case for CSS classes and IDs

### Code Quality
- Add error handling for user inputs and API calls
- Use consistent indentation (2 or 4 spaces)
- Keep functions small and focused on a single responsibility
- Avoid global variables when possible

### Documentation
- Use Portuguese for comments and documentation (as this is a learning project in Portuguese)
- Include examples in code comments when helpful
- Keep README files updated with project changes
